subject: Join Our Monthly Webinar with Dr. Richard Boles
body:
** Join Us for Our Monthly Webinar!
------------------------------------------------------------

Join Our Monthly Webinar with Dr. Richard Boles!

We invite you to join us this Saturday, May 23rd at 9:00 AM PST / 12:00 PM EST for our upcoming monthly webinar featuring Dr. Richard Boles discussing Mitochondrial Health and Dietary Supplements for Autism.

During this educational presentation, Dr. Boles will share insights into the important role mitochondrial function can play in autism and neurological health, along with discussions on nutritional and dietary supplement approaches that may support overall wellness. This webinar is designed for parents, caregivers, practitioners, and anyone interested in learning more about emerging perspectives in autism and complex neurological conditions.

Do not miss this opportunity to hear from one of the leading voices in mitochondrial health and autism research.

Register using the link below to attend.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_zLOB4-CnTwSznd2_KqeflA?mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

AHS Recordings Now Available Online

Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online.

This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace.

We are offering two recording options:
• General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members
• Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits

Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit.
BUY HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Save the Date: Cocktails for A Cause
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA.

Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences.

Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions.

We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?gbtid=a23a5433-a8ec-4114-9d95-978462f7661b&mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year

We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards.

Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children.

The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as:
“An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.”

We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference.

Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com (https://track.pstmrk.it/3/www.warriormom.com%2F/b43o/wnbFAQ/AQ/6c680ed6-2635-49e7-8aaa-ca5f583946a9/4/mxPAv6kITa?mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID)

VOTE HERE (https://apply.internationalimpactbookawards.com/public-voting-form?mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=d90d9383f3&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

Now is the chance to grow our slim majority, Fellow American!

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41381%2E3422442%2EA_CYjg)
**Peter, we’re in the final two weeks until the primary** —and every day between now and June 2 could decide the future of California.
_Californians are working themselves to the bone and still can't make rent. Groceries cost more. Health care is out of reach. Child care is unaffordable._
It’s not some mystery—it's what happens when politicians spend years protecting the corporations and special interests who fund their campaigns instead of the people they're supposed to serve.
I'm a single mom who clips coupons and drives a minivan. I know what it costs to fill up the tank.
I've spent my career showing up, whiteboard in hand, asking the hard questions, and refusing to let powerful interests off the hook.
I'm running to build a California where working families can actually get ahead: less expensive housing, free child care, single-payer health care, tuition-free public college.
**The politicians who made this mess don't get to decide California's future, Peter.**
We have **14 days left** to reach voters with our message. Every ad we’ve put on the air, every town hall on our Whiteboard Warriors tour, every chance I’ve had to step onto the debate stage—it’s all been powered by this grassroots team.
**Now we need one final push to cut through the noise, surge into the top two, and secure our spot on the November ballot.**
**[If you can, please chip in $5 or whatever you’re able to today to help us reach as many voters as possible in these next two weeks.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260519_1_ak.l7aUGm&refcode=em20260519-41381&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41381%2E3422442%2EA_CYjg)**

Thank you,
Katie

subject: We’re trying to keep up
body:
The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

| | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcuO3CAQRb8G79wyL9ssWERqeTdZRJGyRNVQuFEbTHjMKH8feTI_kG3VqSPVvb_ezBuEI6T9O0TUpXlTqvnAgq38CWlv5wsx92zYxOZxkiNVF0AHp511QO2Ami6LYlRKugxP7dYVKWPSu0VxXJxC4dXqVyoYX5lXQ9CXapJU0ZVTOd_EKsQM8-QEdfBgnogJDiztVjD3xxEspAb15c9i8WbPOBz62VquhH8jbCNsq2h7wRskdGe7CMK21ksKaR_zGVIbewXCtkVJ_5ALjgoVHwU6GBUiH8Gv3kukOCMQvtWzF4vGng4Jv__4udFJSMEIm3uLJqILPRJ-xwjh-Br-OyH8_oTioL4M2N9fKwsxQ9gT4feWewUDtoX3UONnokPRLn-E4wh1XoiY9kv6-WT7jy7eNfsbAAD__2oolW4)
---
| | Friend,
---
I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcuO3CAQRb8G79wyL9ssWERqeTdZRJGyRNVQuFEbTHjMKH8feTI_kG3VqSPVvb_ezBuEI6T9O0TUpXlTqvnAgq38CWlv5wsx92zYxOZxkiNVF0AHp511QO2Ami6LYlRKugxP7dYVKWPSu0VxXJxC4dXqVyoYX5lXQ9CXapJU0ZVTOd_EKsQM8-QEdfBgnogJDiztVjD3xxEspAb15c9i8WbPOBz62VquhH8jbCNsq2h7wRskdGe7CMK21ksKaR_zGVIbewXCtkVJ_5ALjgoVHwU6GBUiH8Gv3kukOCMQvtWzF4vGng4Jv__4udFJSMEIm3uLJqILPRJ-xwjh-Br-OyH8_oTioL4M2N9fKwsxQ9gT4feWewUDtoX3UONnokPRLn-E4wh1XoiY9kv6-WT7jy7eNfsbAAD__2oolW4)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcuO3CAQRb8G79wyL9ssWERqeTdZRJGyRNVQuFEbTHjMKH8feTI_kG3VqSPVvb_ezBuEI6T9O0TUpXlTqvnAgq38CWlv5wsx92zYxOZxkiNVF0AHp511QO2Ami6LYlRKugxP7dYVKWPSu0VxXJxC4dXqVyoYX5lXQ9CXapJU0ZVTOd_EKsQM8-QEdfBgnogJDiztVjD3xxEspAb15c9i8WbPOBz62VquhH8jbCNsq2h7wRskdGe7CMK21ksKaR_zGVIbewXCtkVJ_5ALjgoVHwU6GBUiH8Gv3kukOCMQvtWzF4vGng4Jv__4udFJSMEIm3uLJqILPRJ-xwjh-Br-OyH8_oTioL4M2N9fKwsxQ9gT4feWewUDtoX3UONnokPRLn-E4wh1XoiY9kv6-WT7jy7eNfsbAAD__2oolW4)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcuO3CAQRb8G79wyL9ssWERqeTdZRJGyRNVQuFEbTHjMKH8feTI_kG3VqSPVvb_ezBuEI6T9O0TUpXlTqvnAgq38CWlv5wsx92zYxOZxkiNVF0AHp511QO2Ami6LYlRKugxP7dYVKWPSu0VxXJxC4dXqVyoYX5lXQ9CXapJU0ZVTOd_EKsQM8-QEdfBgnogJDiztVjD3xxEspAb15c9i8WbPOBz62VquhH8jbCNsq2h7wRskdGe7CMK21ksKaR_zGVIbewXCtkVJ_5ALjgoVHwU6GBUiH8Gv3kukOCMQvtWzF4vGng4Jv__4udFJSMEIm3uLJqILPRJ-xwjh-Br-OyH8_oTioL4M2N9fKwsxQ9gT4feWewUDtoX3UONnokPRLn-E4wh1XoiY9kv6-WT7jy7eNfsbAAD__2oolW4)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student's hands today?](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcuO3CAQRb8G79wyL9ssWERqeTdZRJGyRNVQuFEbTHjMKH8feTI_kG3VqSPVvb_ezBuEI6T9O0TUpXlTqvnAgq38CWlv5wsx92zYxOZxkiNVF0AHp511QO2Ami6LYlRKugxP7dYVKWPSu0VxXJxC4dXqVyoYX5lXQ9CXapJU0ZVTOd_EKsQM8-QEdfBgnogJDiztVjD3xxEspAb15c9i8WbPOBz62VquhH8jbCNsq2h7wRskdGe7CMK21ksKaR_zGVIbewXCtkVJ_5ALjgoVHwU6GBUiH8Gv3kukOCMQvtWzF4vGng4Jv__4udFJSMEIm3uLJqILPRJ-xwjh-Br-OyH8_oTioL4M2N9fKwsxQ9gT4feWewUDtoX3UONnokPRLn-E4wh1XoiY9kv6-WT7jy7eNfsbAAD__2oolW4)**

---
Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines.

That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward.

That's how this movement actually scales.

Because the reality is, the demand is here now.

The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it.

And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward.

**[Please commit to sending an activism kit to a conservative student today-- and help us keep building a generation that's willing to stand up and fight for this country.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcuO3CAQRb8G79wyL9ssWERqeTdZRJGyRNVQuFEbTHjMKH8feTI_kG3VqSPVvb_ezBuEI6T9O0TUpXlTqvnAgq38CWlv5wsx92zYxOZxkiNVF0AHp511QO2Ami6LYlRKugxP7dYVKWPSu0VxXJxC4dXqVyoYX5lXQ9CXapJU0ZVTOd_EKsQM8-QEdfBgnogJDiztVjD3xxEspAb15c9i8WbPOBz62VquhH8jbCNsq2h7wRskdGe7CMK21ksKaR_zGVIbewXCtkVJ_5ALjgoVHwU6GBUiH8Gv3kukOCMQvtWzF4vGng4Jv__4udFJSMEIm3uLJqILPRJ-xwjh-Br-OyH8_oTioL4M2N9fKwsxQ9gT4feWewUDtoX3UONnokPRLn-E4wh1XoiY9kv6-WT7jy7eNfsbAAD__2oolW4)**

One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you.

If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now.

Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school.

This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it.

And we don't take that lightly.

I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work.
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Andrew Sypher** Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA

**P.S.** Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture.

But moments like this don't sustain themselves.

If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple.

**We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. **

clean_body: The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
I want to
talk about something personal for a moment.

People assume the hardest part of being Secretary of State was overseeing
elections during a pandemic or defending our democracy during one of the
most divisive moments in modern history.

And honestly, those were tough.

But the hardest part was watching lies and misinformation put a target on
my family, my team, and Michigan election workers simply because we did
our jobs and told the truth.

When armed protesters showed up outside my home after the 2020 election,
and Trump repeatedly attacked me, it would’ve been easier to stay quiet,
back down, or stop fighting altogether.

But moments like that also remind you why this work matters. Because if
public servants give in to intimidation, if we stop standing up for what’s
right because it’s difficult or unpopular, then the people spreading lies
and threats win.

I’ve spent my career standing up for civil rights, and now I’m running for
governor because I believe leadership is about showing up, telling the
truth, and doing the right thing even when it’s hard.

And it’s why I’m asking for your support today. Extremists are threatening
to move Michigan backwards, and they’re pouring millions into this race to
try to build off Trump’s 2024 win.

body:
Three minutes at the microphone: What Colorado’s 2026 session really looked like
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Howdy folks!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Under the Golden Dome...** Colorado’s 2026 [legislative session ended with major fights](https://link.email.joinrmv.) over elections, immigration, gun rights, and local control. Lawmakers approved House Bill 1113 [extending ballot mailing timelines](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and expanding emergency election authority, while Republican-backed voter-roll and cybersecurity amendments failed. Critics also argued [public testimony had little effect](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as bills on housing, red flag laws, immigration, and parental rights advanced largely along party lines, fueling new grassroots activism heading into 2026.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Colorado is now the [third-most expensive state](https://link.email.joinrmv.) in the nation, with worsening housing affordability putting growing pressure on working families. Meanwhile, a Douglas County resident [died from hantavirus](https://link.email.joinrmv.) after likely exposure to infected rodents, and Colorado’s climate lawsuit against Exxon and Suncor is now headed toward a [major U.S. Supreme Court showdown](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage/Commentary Spotlight...** Thousands gathered on the National Mall for [“Rededicate 250,”](https://link.email.joinrmv.) where faith leaders called for [renewed moral leadership](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and a [return to America’s founding principles](https://link.email.joinrmv.) ahead of the nation’s 250th anniversary. Meanwhile, the DOJ reached a settlement requiring Texas Children’s Hospital to [end gender-transition procedures for minors](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and open the nation’s first detransitioner clinic, marking a major shift in the debate over youth gender medicine.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, May 19, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Three minutes at the microphone: What Colorado’s 2026 session really looked like](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
_**From housing fights and election battles to late-night hearings and grassroots backlash, the 2026 session left many Coloradans questioning where decisions are really made.**_
Arrive early. Sign up fast. Wait six hours. Get three minutes at the microphone.
By April, Colorado citizens had learned the Capitol routine.
Parents waited to testify on parental rights and gender policy bills. Survivors of child trafficking described years of trauma while lawmakers debated sentencing standards. Gun owners warned against expanding red flag authority to what Senate Bill 26-004 would ultimately define as “institutional petitioners”—a category now including schools, healthcare facilities and behavioral-health entities authorized to seek firearm seizure orders. Local officials fought state zoning preemption proposals.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.**
Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds.
_America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._
Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Families Struggle as Colorado Climbs to Third Most Expensive State](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Colorado is now the third-most expensive state in the nation:** New data from the Colorado Chamber of Commerce shows the state ranked 47th in affordability and 48th in housing affordability, with costs worsening steadily over the past several years.
* **Housing costs continue squeezing working families:** The report highlights growing financial strain as home prices, rent, and overall living expenses push many middle-class residents further from homeownership and long-term stability.
* **Economic strengths are increasingly overshadowed by affordability concerns:** While Colorado continues performing well in areas like business friendliness, health, and GDP growth, rising living costs are making it harder for average families to fully benefit from the state’s economic success.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Colorado Moves Toward Month Long Voting Under New Elections Bill](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Colorado elections could effectively become “election month”:** House Bill 1113 would require ballots to be mailed earlier — up to 29 days before Election Day — while also giving the governor expanded emergency powers to respond to election disruptions.
* **Democrats say changes are aimed at protecting elections from federal interference:** Sponsors argued the bill is needed to guard against potential USPS delays and other disruptions tied to concerns about the Trump administration’s election policies, while critics warn the measure expands executive authority over elections.
* **Bill includes several additional election changes:** The legislation would restrict certain individuals from serving as election watchers, require colleges to send voting information to students, and create new procedures allowing voters to challenge another person’s registration status.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[The meekness weapon: The hill where warriors win](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | MAY 19** _We continue with our nursery rhyme, The Itsy Bitsy Spider – Part Two. So, become that child again and remember: The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the waterspout... Most are familiar with the rest. Christianity is more than a fleeting encounter with Jesus. It means following Him into a radically different reality that begins on a mountain. Let’s start with our spider._ __
**[From a Detroit crack house to the National Mall: The pastor Colorado sees in June](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MAY 17** _Lorenzo Sewell sold drugs on Detroit’s east side as a kid. His father went to prison for murder. His younger brother was killed by a car. Today he stands on the National Mall with House Speaker Mike Johnson and War Secretary Pete Hegseth, part of a national moment of rededication that organizers expect to draw 15,000 people._
__

**[Colorado’s $500,000 Medicaid commission has no mandate to investigate fraud](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MAY 15** _Colorado lawmakers spent weeks debating a new commission to study Medicaid sustainability. The bill they sent to Gov. Jared Polis on May 9 names three major failures inside the state’s Medicaid system in its legislative declaration—the post-COVID eligibility purge, the rideshare scandal and the autism therapy audit. But the bill never directs the commission to investigate fraud, waste or abuse._ __

name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: Protect vote-by-mail
body:
| | Peter,

Washington votes by mail. It’s how we’ve done it for _years_.

If you’re registered, your ballot comes to you. You can mail it back, drop it in a secure box, and trust that it will be processed the way it should be. **The system works.**

Politicians like the president and his most extreme allies are trying to make it harder for states like ours to keep voting by mail.

**Washingtonians don’t need more red tape between them and their ballot.**

I believe we can protect election security without tearing apart a system that is safe, secure, and reliable but I want to be able to prove it – so where do you stand?

[_**Do you agree we should protect Washington’s vote-by-mail system?

Please weigh in - it only takes 30-seconds and it makes a huge difference.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131706383/622042206/-1846556574?refcode=MGP_EM_PT_90DO_260519_1_1&refcode2=a28127dd-b853-f111-8ef3-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjgxMjdkZC1iODUzLWYxMTEtOGVmMy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X3aHBJYKNuFo5vhx2wEdl88KRDJ30e9WsSH8Y85eApM=&emci=19ee1091-b853-f111-8ef3-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=a28127dd-b853-f111-8ef3-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=31138575) Vote-by-mail matters for working parents, rural voters, seniors, veterans, people with disabilities, and anyone who faces major barriers to voting.

**It’s practical. It’s secure. And here in Washington - it’s how we vote.**

Thanks for making your voice heard.

Marie

Trump just nominated two
more cronies to lifetime seats on the federal bench — and their records
are terrifying.

Kasdin Mitchell put her name on a legal brief arguing that racial
discrimination in voting had "thankfully faded away" in the South.
(Spoiler: it hadn't.)

Angela Colmenero spent years defending Texas voter ID laws that federal
courts found were designed with the purpose of discriminating against
Black and Latino voters.

Now, Trump wants to reward them with lifetime judgeships in Texas — a
state with one of the worst histories of voter suppression in the country.

This is a pattern and it’s disqualifying.

Mitchell and Colmenero didn't just argue on the wrong side of history.
They helped build the legal foundation for the voter suppression that's
happening right now.

And if they're confirmed, they'll spend decades ruling on the exact cases
their work made possible.

That's how you rig a system. And it's exactly what Trump is doing.

Demand Justice PAC is digging into their records, sounding the alarm, and
mobilizing opposition before it's too late. These nominees could face the
Senate Judiciary Committee soon — which means the pressure we apply right
now is what matters.

Friend,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

clean_body: Why this Memorial Day matters more than ever It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Friend, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. ---
Hi friend — One of my favorite parts of this campaign has been getting out across Rhode Island and having real conversations with people face-to-face. I’m not talking about official speaking engagements or political theater. These events are just people gathering in living rooms, community centers, coffee shops, radio studios, and anywhere there’s space to talk honestly about what Rhode Islanders need from their government right now — and what the Lieutenant Governor’s office _could_ be if we expected more from it. _And if you have thoughts on that —_[** _I want to hear them, share here_ _!_**](https://sue4ri.com/l/vDqk47m5CHZp) So I wanted to bring a little bit of that “on the road” energy directly to you today. (Plus, if you’re anything like me, you get how big of a deal it is to get folks to travel anywhere in this state — I’m so grateful!)
---
**⬇️ Here are a few recent stops from the campaign trail ⬇️**
---
| |
**📍 Cranston**

I had such a great conversation with the folks at this gathering about the kind of new energy we can bring to the Lieutenant Governor’s office. They had thoughtful questions about affordability, climate resilience, how we fight fascism with community, and what it actually looks like when government listens before it acts.

Honestly, one of the biggest themes of the night was this feeling that people are ready for leadership that feels more accessible, collaborative, and that actually takes responsibility. They are ready for an LG who wants to roll her sleeves up and get something done. That’s me!
* * *
**📍 Woonsocket**

I stopped by Coalition Radio in Woonsocket to chat with Pat Ford about something I care about deeply: how government can actually work with people to get things done.

We talked about energy policy, traffic safety, collaboration, and what it means to build a government that’s responsive instead of reactive. These are exactly the kinds of conversations shaping this campaign every single day. Did you hear it? **[If not, you can find the recording here>>](https://sue4ri.com/l/2OZYumxGHcW6)**
* * *
**📍 Providence**

This (beautiful!) stop at Mare in Wayland Square, Providence, left me feeling genuinely hopeful about Rhode Island’s future. We talked about housing, affordability, climate, and what people want to see from their leaders right now.

But more than anything, I left inspired by how engaged and thoughtful everyone was. These conversations remind me why I’m running in the first place.

---
Honestly? I wish every single one of you could pull up a chair at one of these events. So let me ask:
---
💬 **[If you were sitting with me at one of these house parties, what question would you want to ask me about this race or my vision for Lieutenant Governor?](https://sue4ri.com/l/ebUJiTWJGEt6)** | | [ **SUBMIT YOUR QUESTION** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/PlKXgcT96MlU)
---
And if you want to help us keep this kind of organizing going — more stops, more conversations, more community events across Rhode Island — **[you can chip in here, too:](https://sue4ri.com/l/ymwdrmTZ7crM)**

---

clean_body: | | Hi friend — One of my favorite parts of this campaign has been getting out across Rhode Island and having real conversations with people face-to-face. I’m not talking about official speaking engagements or political theater. These events are just people gathering in living rooms, community centers, coffee shops, radio studios, and anywhere there’s space to talk honestly about what Rhode Islanders need from their government right now — and what the Lieutenant Governor’s office could be if we expected more from it. And if you have thoughts on that — So I wanted to bring a little bit of that “on the road” energy directly to you today. (Plus, if you’re anything like me, you get how big of a deal it is to get folks to travel anywhere in this state — I’m so grateful!) ⬇️ Here are a few recent stops from the campaign trail ⬇️ | | 📍 Cranston I had such a great conversation with the folks at this gathering about the kind of new energy we can bring to the Lieutenant Governor’s office. They had thoughtful questions about affordability, climate resilience, how we fight fascism with community, and what it actually looks like when government listens before it acts. Honestly, one of the biggest themes of the night was this feeling that people are ready for leadership that feels more accessible, collaborative, and that actually takes responsibility. They are ready for an LG who wants to roll her sleeves up and get something done. That’s me! 📍 Woonsocket I stopped by Coalition Radio in Woonsocket to chat with Pat Ford about something I care about deeply: how government can actually work with people to get things done. We talked about energy policy, traffic safety, collaboration, and what it means to build a government that’s responsive instead of reactive. These are exactly the kinds of conversations shaping this campaign every single day. Did you hear it? 📍 Providence This (beautiful!) stop at Mare in Wayland Square, Providence, left me feeling genuinely hopeful about Rhode Island’s future. We talked about housing, affordability, climate, and what people want to see from their leaders right now. But more than anything, I left inspired by how engaged and thoughtful everyone was. These conversations remind me why I’m running in the first place. Honestly? I wish every single one of you could pull up a chair at one of these events. So let me ask: 💬 | | And if you want to help us keep this kind of organizing going — more stops, more conversations, more community events across Rhode Island — | This campaign is growing because people are showing up for it. I fell into a coma. I was put on a ventilator. I was given my last rites.

**A coma couldn’t take me down. Neither will this bloodthirsty left-wing prosecutor!**

During my coma, I had a deeply spiritual experience.
---
Humbly, I cannot say I was headed straight for heaven. Rather, it felt like I was headed to a trial by St. Peter where all my life’s deeds were put on display.
---
That moment put everything in perspective.
---
**No matter what happens in my RIGGED TRIAL in Arizona, the ONLY trial that ultimately matters is the one before God.**

**_And I can say with absolute confidence that when I was tested, I chose to stand by my principles – even if it meant getting _ARRESTED_ ... TWICE!_**

So, just as I’ve fought the Mafia, the Deep State, countless witch hunts, and now _even a coma_ , I will fight this rigged case against me – and WIN!

**_But to win, I’m going to need the best defense I can get. Just as I heavily relied on your prayers, I’m honestly going to need your support to secure a top-notch defense to beat a left-wing prosecutor hell-bent on throwing me in prison._**

Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.

But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.

They're not asking for a handout. They're asking for a break. So I gave them one.

As Governor of Kentucky, I just cut the state gas tax. Because when you have the chance to ease the burden on working families, you do it.

But one governor can only do so much. The real change, the change that reaches every family in every state, happens when we elect Democratic governors and legislators all across this country who are willing to do the same.

clean_body: Peter, I want to tell you about something I've been hearing a lot lately. At every event I go to – whether it’s in Kentucky, Michigan, Georgia, or Ohio – people pull me aside and tell me the same thing. Gas prices. Groceries. The cost of just getting through the month. They're not asking for a handout. They're asking for a break. So I gave them one. As Governor of Kentucky, I just cut the state gas tax. Because when you have the chance to ease the burden on working families, you do it. But one governor can only do so much. The real change, the change that reaches every family in every state, happens when we elect Democratic governors and legislators all across this country who are willing to do the same. That's what I'm working toward and that's why I'm asking for your support today. Every dollar you give helps us elect leaders who will show up for working families the way working families show up for this country every single day. = With gratitude, Andy Beshear | | Kentucky Gov. Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. No matter where I go, I'm a proud Pueblo woman.

When I wear my mocs or my ribbon skirt, I'm reminded of how powerful traditional clothing is in sharing our heritage. From my ancestral homelands to the halls of Congress, I rock my mocs everywhere I go. And it reminds me to honor the shoulders I stand on.

body:
Sara Jacobs - Democrat, U.S. Congress [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89313/images/SDS/SJJ-emailheader1.png]
Friend, I’m heartbroken for the students, parents, faculty, and everyone affected by yesterday’s shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego.
Everyone should be able to gather, learn, and worship in peace, and I’m so angry that a place of comfort and safety was taken from our community.
I hope our Muslim community can soon find peace and healing. But healing won’t be possible without accountability — for the violence, and for the anti-Muslim and anti-Islam rhetoric that fueled it.
We all need to come together to address the hatred and violence aimed at dividing us and pitting us against each other. It’s our collective responsibility to heal divisions and lead with compassion and understanding.
If you’re looking for a way to support the individuals and families impacted by this tragic shooting, the Islamic Center has established the official ICSD Victim & Family Support Fund to provide direct recovery support. You can make a contribution here. [https://goodbricks.org/campaign/icsd.org/official-icsd-victim---family-support-fund?fbclid=IwZnRzaAR4pkhleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZAo2NjI4NTY4Mzc5AAEeKP37amL8bnmle2v07OK4UUQUSphH8gEF0BEvwtIZd0ITY8QNoAobC5WWl04_aem_UTq-BHDZb1T2-hWHbpZXQw]
I’m thankful for this team for standing together in moments like this.

Sara

body:
Meet Claire, Christian, Jacob, and Tyler.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260519-1&t=1&akid=3498%2E587540%2ESAYMCR)
Peter,
**Leaders We Deserve is proud to announce we’re officially endorsing:**
⭐ **Claire Heinrich** for Missouri HD-110
⭐ **Christian Phelps** for Wisconsin HD-93
⭐ **Jacob Martinez** for Arizona LD-09
⭐ **Tyler Smith** for Texas HD-138
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260519_1_endorsements.ZUpduI&refcode=em20260519-3498&t=2&akid=3498%2E587540%2ESAYMCR)
**[I’ll tell you about each of them, but first, will you split a $5 donation between Claire, Christian, Jacob, Tyler, and Leaders We Deserve today to help power their campaigns to victory?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260519_1_endorsements.ZUpduI&refcode=em20260519-3498&amount=5&t=3&akid=3498%2E587540%2ESAYMCR)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260519_1_endorsements.ZUpduI&amount=5&refcode=em20260519-3498&t=4&akid=3498%2E587540%2ESAYMCR)**
**Claire Heinrich** grew up on the south banks of the Missouri River, raised in a family that taught her the value of hard work and community. Claire always knew she wanted to run for office. Not to be in power — but to serve her community and make sure the voices of District 110 were respected and heard in Jefferson City.
In Jefferson City, Claire will fight to protect Missouri’s public schools from having taxpayer dollars siphoned into private school vouchers. She’ll fight to fix District 110’s aging roads and bridges, and address erosion and water management issues across the district. And she’ll demand that the tax dollars her constituents send to the capital actually come back to the community instead of giving away taxpayer money to massive corporations that exploit workers.
Claire is up against two conservative opponents. One is a former Trump campaign coordinator who has pushed for anti-immigrant policies like opposing sanctuary cities, and the other is campaigning on a tax plan that would devastate funding for the public schools District 110 depends on. In contrast, Claire’s path has always been guided by what her community needs — and that’s exactly why she’ll win.
**[Split a Donation](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260519_1_endorsements.ZUpduI&amount=5&refcode=em20260519-3498&t=5&akid=3498%2E587540%2ESAYMCR)**
**Christian Phelps** knows exactly what working people’s priorities are right now. An education advocate and union member, he has spent his career fighting for working families and the public services they depend on. Christian earned his masters in journalism, and spent 5 years as Communications Director for Wisconsin Public Education Network, learning the ins and outs of the state legislature and what it really takes to fight for the issues that matter most. In 2024, he won a tough Democratic primary by just 313 votes, then flipped a state house seat Republicans had held for 14 consecutive years.
As a Wisconsin State Representative, Christian has hit the ground running. He co-authored the Healthy School Meals for All bill, introduced legislation to ban gender identity discrimination in employment, housing, and education, authored a bill to rein in corporations using algorithmic software to drive up rent, and introduced the Keep Families Together package to protect immigrant families from ICE’s terror. In Madison, he’ll continue fighting to fully fund public schools for the first time in 20 years, restore collective bargaining rights, and make universal healthcare a reality for every family in the Chippewa Valley.
Christian is currently running unopposed in the primary, but faces a competitive general election. He’s already proven he has what it takes to flip a district, be effective in the state house, and win — he just needs enough grassroots support to get him over the finish line.

Peter, You know that feeling of money just flying out of your bank account? That’s my reality in this final stretch of the primary runoff election. Every day, money is leaving our bank account, sometimes even faster than we can bring it in. We’re paying to keep our TV ad on the air through next Tuesday. We’re paying for digital, for voter outreach, and for everything it takes to communicate with people across Texas in the last week of a statewide race. If we stay on the air, we reach voters. If we don’t, we don’t. That’s the reality. We are making the case that Texans can have faith in the Attorney General’s office again. That it can be independent. That it can serve as a check on abuse of power. That it can work the way it was intended to work. Voters are hearing that message right now, but we have to sustain it. We have to be ready for what comes next. After the race is called, the general election starts immediately. There is no pause. No reset. We have to be ready on election night to compete statewide. That means we cannot come out of this week with an empty account. We need to replenish what we are spending now so we are ready the second this race moves to the next phase: defeating whichever far-right wingnut makes it out of the Republican primary. clean_body: Help us hit the ground running To unsubscribe, | | Peter, You know that feeling of money just flying out of your bank account? That’s my reality in this final stretch of the primary runoff election. Every day, money is leaving our bank account, sometimes even faster than we can bring it in. We’re paying to keep our TV ad on the air through next Tuesday. We’re paying for digital, for voter outreach, and for everything it takes to communicate with people across Texas in the last week of a statewide race. If we stay on the air, we reach voters. If we don’t, we don’t. That’s the reality. We are making the case that Texans can have faith in the Attorney General’s office again. That it can be independent. That it can serve as a check on abuse of power. That it can work the way it was intended to work. Voters are hearing that message right now, but we have to sustain it. We have to be ready for what comes next. After the race is called, the general election starts immediately. There is no pause. No reset. We have to be ready on election night to compete statewide. That means we cannot come out of this week with an empty account. We need to replenish what we are spending now so we are ready the second this race moves to the next phase: defeating whichever far-right wingnut makes it out of the Republican primary. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. = = = = = = This is how we finish strong and hit the ground running. – Nathan Johnson Democratic State Senator Democratic Candidate for Texas Attorney General | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- | Political ad paid for by Nathan Johnson Campaign Nathan Johnson Campaign PO Box 5325 Austin, TX 78763 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

body:
But now, my final trial awaits...
| Dear Peter,
---
I fell into a coma. I was put on a ventilator. I was given my last rites.
---
But by the grace of God and the power of _YOUR_ prayers...
---
**_...I’M BACK!_**
---
I’m a _fighter_ to my core – and now I’m 100% recovered and ready to win the FINAL BATTLE for my freedom against a vengeful Democrat Attorney General who wants to **IMPRISON** me for _20 YEARS_!
---
**A coma couldn’t take me down. Neither will this bloodthirsty left-wing prosecutor!**
---
During my coma, I had a deeply spiritual experience.
---
Humbly, I cannot say I was headed straight for heaven. Rather, it felt like I was headed to a trial by St. Peter where all my life’s deeds were put on display.
---
That moment put everything in perspective.
---
**No matter what happens in my RIGGED TRIAL in Arizona, the ONLY trial that ultimately matters is the one before God.**
---
**_And I can say with absolute confidence that when I was tested, I chose to stand by my principles – even if it meant getting _ARRESTED_ ... TWICE!_**
---
So, just as I’ve fought the Mafia, the Deep State, countless witch hunts, and now _even a coma_ , I will fight this rigged case against me – and WIN!
---
**_But to win, I’m going to need the best defense I can get. Just as I heavily relied on your prayers, I’m honestly going to need your support to secure a top-notch defense to beat a left-wing prosecutor hell-bent on throwing me in prison._**

clean_body: They looked like ordinary people The men arrested included a teacher, a cruise ship worker... and even a Santa Claus | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Peter, Most people think child traffickers look evil. They don't. Sometimes they look like a teacher. Sometimes they look like a cruise ship worker smiling at families on vacation. Sometimes they even dress like Santa Claus. That is the terrifying truth America is waking up to. And sadly, the news today reminds us why this mission matters so much. Disney cruise ship staffers among 28 arrested in massive child pornography operation. Well-known Santa Claus among 19 arrested in child predator sting. High School math teacher among 89 arrested in human trafficking operation. Three different stories. Three different places. But all convey one chilling truth ties them all together: The people who prey on children are hiding in plain sight. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Years ago, after hearing firsthand stories about trafficked children, my life changed forever. What I learned broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold like products. And most people had no idea this darkness existed. Thart's why I helped create the Sound of Freedom film. Not for fame. Not for Hollywood. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. Many people told us the movie would fail. Studios rejected it. Doors closed. But I could not stay silent. When innocent children are suffering, silence becomes part of the problem. Recently, while accepting the Catholic Champion Award, I shared the promise that still guides my life today: " I made a promise to God, to dedicate my life to ending child trafficking because God's children are not for sale." That promise became the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Today, we are working to protect vulnerable children through prevention, rescue support, education, awareness, and advocacy. We help strengthen struggling families before traffickers can target their children. We equip trusted partners working to rescue exploited children. We educate parents and communities about warning signs predators use to groom and manipulate children. We advocate for stronger laws to protect innocent lives. Jesus said: " Let the little children come to me... for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is created by God with dignity. Every child deserves safety. And every one of us has a choice: Look away or stand up and protect them. That's why I am reaching out to you today. Peter, will you make your first gift to help stop the sale of God's children? predators are hiding in plain sight. But together, we can shine light into the darkness. And together, we can tell the world: God 's Children are Not For Sale.** For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Why? Because for Donald Trump, the rules are suggestions and the health of the public is an afterthought. This is the Trump agenda in a nutshell: reckless impulses driven by vanity and lawlessness. He wanted a grander East Wing, and he didn't care what laws got broken or who got poisoned to make it happen. Whether it’s gutting healthcare or dumping heavy metals into our soil, his disregard for human safety is a feature, not a bug. At Able Dems, we know that for the disability community, these impulses are life-threatening. We need leaders who respect the law and value our lives. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. ** In rage and solidarity, -Able Dems | elects Democrats with disabilities. We fight to protect accessible voting, expand health care and Social Security, and equality for all. body:
Politicians moved people around like they were solving a puzzle, not representing a state.

| | | | |
---
Hey y’all, I have spent my entire life in communities like the ones that just got carved up by politicians. Including my own community, where I have been Mayor for two terms, which they carved into two districts. And if that makes you as angry as it makes me, I could use your help right now. [**Can you chip in $10 today?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Byx7SmYOkHxmrEIth5xTbA~~/AAUS1hA~/bBmuSoqkQuxgVHfnFXtAVe1uR7pAbdHwgiHZ8ANtge6_3tfj_eR3n3C2WQz0PqYfFNh5utYSERTo67vswlPlMeOQ4FhPQsimCaif3Wt-gVl-vOpwDiuVtF_bB8cVKbH3hGmHhkX2M_WjkNI1k2q8w_MDM1iGq3L2LfyFMM0Rj8N4z-KyXLMToWRBniWmezq92_p-pX7QOyf_CsWZub3HRrAJ8kS7xtFNj0bxngmTISqsHzHZf3j6lfFQuXw1l188ryvg6Qu3pmEYWHLqGUHczuODhFi0aUMoXCSh_R3P6CA~) | | [ CHIP IN $10](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/37E0HMt01wMhmXegaIhQOA~~/AAUS1hA~/bBmuSoqkQuxgVHfnFXtAVe1uR7pAbdHwgiHZ8ANtge6_3tfj_eR3n3C2WQz0PqYfFNh5utYSERTo67vswlPlMeOQ4FhPQsimCaif3Wt-gVl-vOpwDiuVtF_bB8cVKbH3hGmHhkX2M_WjkNI1k2q8w_MDM1iGq3L2LfyFMM0Rj8N4z-KyXLMToWRBniWmezq9iWFdAnX2IckXY8dg9K4vPyorU1C1MFiTenMNinZTIx-wq0xaChtyfeIBtyJS1PokLr9hApdGZr7d7m57URfBQQFZ1i_rY9PmXWhZZRejHF4~)
---
I grew up riding my bike to the downtown square in Columbia. I spent three years in Memphis learning the law and falling in love with that city. I married the love of my life at the First Baptist Church in Ripley. I know what it means to belong somewhere. To have roots. To care about your neighbors.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/3Zs6AtyzLrjy_oLEx3Gmcg~~/AAUS1hA~/kt0KV6qCu6Y-DeanOEdSJIoHJTRVMQOa6LNRGxxU56LGMpEIk5mR76btgdbZvwnCMmnPdQlAsIQaBwSXlDrh7OwynUyjcuunKxJCJBHpp0nP_EOSOnoFzZ_GpFZjz_5elozIsFeUuDMQAx-nY7tkZGeSvgOlldPjgKeUPq6uAYu7UzTGwWSMpZffvLcNQG3HJdlDRkyQJxeIEtt5QFwuP3w4LWeT_wPa3S_eaA50bKHLwT8GupHGw_4wR3lOlNQAljh7N0Tk3uuLrml78cujpA~~)
These places are not interchangeable. They are not lines on a map. They are certainly not pieces of a puzzle to be rearranged whenever it is politically convenient. But that is exactly how the politicians in Nashville treated them. They sat down with a map and moved people around like they were solving a puzzle, not representing a state.
I am still running because I believe public service means something. It means showing up for the people who sent you, not protecting the people who drew your lines. The new 5th District is bigger now, and so is our responsibility to get this right.

But Trump, Peters, and the MAGA movement are still trying to undermine trust in our democracy. They know I will stand in their way as Attorney General.
That’s why this race matters so much.

Friend,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

clean_body: Why this Memorial Day matters more than ever It's Gary Sinise here. | | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Friend, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Tim Holbert President American Veterans Center | | | The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131711115/622057456/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTM3ODk5ZS1jNjUzLWYxMTEtOGVmMy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6ZhSv_F6_jS4S5gnuQhUBrDi37RymJb6bNZTpyRzfXM=)
Donald Trump is selling access to the presidency.

His family is cashing in. His allies are benefiting. And this Administration continues to blur the line between public service and personal profit every single day.

name: Sen. Tammy Duckworth via 314 Action
subject: Dr. Adam Hamawy saved my life. Join me in supporting his first-ever run for office.
body:
If it weren’t for Dr. Adam Hamawy I don’t know if I’d be alive to write you this message or serve in the Senate.
#
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=202601-314-hamawy-split-leftnet.ErBL41&refcode=em20260519-1631&t=1&akid=1631%2E2118727%2EiDqjp_)
If it weren’t for Dr. Adam Hamawy, **I don’t know if I’d be alive to write you this message or serve in the Senate.**
It is because of his efforts that I survived after my helicopter was shot down in Iraq in 2004. It is because of the countless hours he spent in the operating room racing against the clock that I’m not a triple amputee—his quick thinking actually saved my wounded arm.
**Adam is running for Congress for the first time in a highly competitive race in just 14 days, and polling shows the race is too close to call:**
[**Will you join me in supporting him by splitting a donation between his campaign and 314 Action ahead of his final pre-primary fundraising deadline?**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=202601-314-hamawy-split-leftnet.ErBL41&refcode=em20260519-1631&t=2&akid=1631%2E2118727%2EiDqjp_)
Right now, in 2026, we’re at a perilous crossroads for our country and our democracy.
Americans from all walks of life and backgrounds are looking for leaders with the courage to speak truth to power. Leaders who aren’t afraid to denounce injustice. Leaders who will fight tirelessly for the tens of millions of Americans struggling to get by.
**Adam is that leader.**
I saw his dedication to service firsthand when he was an Army combat trauma surgeon in Iraq and I saw his courage when he risked his life to provide life-saving medical aid in Gaza, Sudan, Syria and Haiti.
**[Please donate today so we can elect a leader to Congress who will fight to end forever wars, make healthcare accessible for all and restore the power of everyday people in our government.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=202601-314-hamawy-split-leftnet.ErBL41&refcode=em20260519-1631&t=3&akid=1631%2E2118727%2EiDqjp_)**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=202601-314-hamawy-split-leftnet.wIUrMZ&refcode=em20260519-1631&amount=5&t=4&akid=1631%2E2118727%2EiDqjp_)**
In service,
Tammy

body:
We are going to make the Trump Administration’s war on the VA an election issue — and Republicans who sat by and let Trump and Doug Collins gut the VA are going to lose their seats.
#
Peter,
Over the last several months, the VetVoice Foundation analyzed wait times at VA Medical Centers. What they found was that wait times increased at 71% of them. Oncology, neurology, pulmonology, mental and women’s health were among the hardest hit care specializations.
We’re Veterans. We use the VA. We know wait times have increased — we’ve experienced it ourselves, and so have our friends and family. We’re sure you have to, or at least people you know. But this VetVoice study was the first of its kind, and it verified all of our anecdotal experiences with hard data.
Now that we can verify that this is happening, it’s time to put names and faces on these wait time increases. We are going to make the Trump Administration’s war on the VA an election issue — and Republicans who sat by and let Trump and Doug Collins gut the VA are going to lose their seats.
So, if you or someone you know have experienced any increased barriers to care at the VA, we want to hear about it. We’ve set up a tipline on the VoteVets website where you can share details, and anything you’d be willing to speak about would be incredibly helpful.
[**If you’re willing, please: Add your story about how Trump cuts to the VA have impacted your experience at the VA. This is really important, and we need to hear from you.**](https://votevets.org/va-tipline?source=em260519-1-120&refcode2=35160.3013755.VHZ4RC)
| [TELL US YOUR STORY](https://votevets.org/va-tipline?source=em260519-1-120&refcode2=35160.3013755.VHZ4RC)
---
One final note: We won’t use any of your information without your permission. We know this is personal. But if you are willing to be a part of this, it will make a huge difference.
Thank you,
The team at VoteVets

body:
When voting rights are protected, our country moves forward.
#
I was with Senator Raphael Warnock the Sunday before last, and we were at Ebenezer Church in Atlanta.
After his beautiful sermon, Senator Warnock took me to the original Ebenezer where Martin Luther King, Jr. preached and organized. We sat inside of that sanctuary, and what struck me was how small it was.
Senator Warnock turned to me and said, “This sanctuary only fit 300 people. Can you believe that just 300 people changed the world?”
Those 300 congregants turned into those congregants at Dexter Avenue Baptist Church in Montgomery, Alabama. And from Dr. King’s work on Dexter Avenue, we saw the launch of the Montgomery Bus Boycotts.
In Montgomery, we saw some of the most cruel repression in the history of America — and we also saw the highest angels of American history rise to create our democracy.
**Because it wasn’t until the Voting Rights Act was passed that we even _had_ a democracy in this country**.
There was no democracy in America until every human being born here was guaranteed and protected the right to vote.
But we know what happened after those bus boycotts. We know what happened on the trail to make sure that we got that legislation passed.
Because **with every expansion, there is an attempt at regression**.
This Supreme Court, under Justice Roberts, is part of that long history of regression and repression in America.
But they do not triumph. You triumph.
I want to make sure that we all understand that Alabama is not alone.
When they ask, “What do we do in this moment? I feel helpless. What action can I take?”
**It is time for the North to roll up to the South**. It is time for New York to pull up to Alabama. It is time for all of us to come to Georgia, to Louisiana, to Tennessee, to Mississippi, and let them know exactly what they have uncorked with this injustice.
They think they can draw us out of power. They do not know the sleeping giant that they just awakened.
Our whole country must understand that it was not until voting rights were ratified that we got the Great Society.
Because when Black Americans have the right to vote, and that vote is protected, our schools get funded.
When voting rights are protected, healthcare gets expanded.
**When voting rights are protected, our country moves forward**.
And that’s what they’re actually afraid of: _they’re afraid of us coming together_. They’re afraid of us protecting one another.
Alabama is the crucible. Georgia, Tennessee, Louisiana, Mississippi is the crucible.
So if you are not from there, it is time to roll up. Because what they thought was the final blow is actually just the opening salvo.
**This is not just rhetoric**. This is serious. So many people have shared with me that they feel powerless and unsure of what to do.
Go to the South. Connect causes. Support the efforts of our brothers and sisters, organizers and community leaders there asking us to amplify their organizing and _go_.
You don't need a 10-step plan. You just need to show up. Answer the call.
I promise you amazing things can happen when we come together. The only thing that has ever changed this country for the better is _regular people_. Not a politician or anyone else.
Your church, your union, your professional groups, school friends, it's time. This is the drumbeat of weeks and months. Your presence and support matters. Show them they are not alone.
We are one. Amplify. **This is the light**.
In solidarity,
Alexandria
There has been a day before this presidency, and there will be a day after.
**And it belongs to us**.

body:
But now, my final trial awaits...
| Dear Friend,
---
I fell into a coma. I was put on a ventilator. I was given my last rites.
---
But by the grace of God and the power of _YOUR_ prayers...
---
**_...I’M BACK!_**
---
I’m a _fighter_ to my core – and now I’m 100% recovered and ready to win the FINAL BATTLE for my freedom against a vengeful Democrat Attorney General who wants to **IMPRISON** me for _20 YEARS_!
---
**A coma couldn’t take me down. Neither will this bloodthirsty left-wing prosecutor!**
---
During my coma, I had a deeply spiritual experience.
---
Humbly, I cannot say I was headed straight for heaven. Rather, it felt like I was headed to a trial by St. Peter where all my life’s deeds were put on display.
---
That moment put everything in perspective.
---
**No matter what happens in my RIGGED TRIAL in Arizona, the ONLY trial that ultimately matters is the one before God.**
---
**_And I can say with absolute confidence that when I was tested, I chose to stand by my principles – even if it meant getting _ARRESTED_ ... TWICE!_**
---
So, just as I’ve fought the Mafia, the Deep State, countless witch hunts, and now _even a coma_ , I will fight this rigged case against me – and WIN!
---
**_But to win, I’m going to need the best defense I can get. Just as I heavily relied on your prayers, I’m honestly going to need your support to secure a top-notch defense to beat a left-wing prosecutor hell-bent on throwing me in prison._**
---

_**By David Shuster**_
There are some Trump cabinet secretaries who dishonor government service by their venality, others by cowardice, and still others by simple stupidity. Kash Patel has managed to achieve all three distinctions simultaneously and with the confidence of a lunatic cannonballing into the shallow end of history.
In the old days of U.S. Presidential administrations, long before Trump and his lackeys turned every institution into a stage for self-promotion and every office into a species of lifestyle celebrity, -- the Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation was expected to exhibit at least the theatrical appearance of sobriety, discipline, and restraint. The job carried a faint ecclesiastical quality.
The FBI director resembled a stern Presbyterian deacon who disapproved of jazz music, dancing, and pleasure generally. Our nation did not require the FBI director to be virtuous. We merely required the FBI head to understand that this post is a solemn public trust, not the director of a taxpayer-funded bachelor party.
Kash Patel has missed the distinction entirely.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
