The reports swirling around him keep accumulating with the hideous magnificence of excrement backing up in a clogged toilet.
There are the allegations Patel used FBI aircraft to ferry his twenty something country singing girlfriend to Penn State University so she could belt out the national anthem at a wrestling match.
There are the reports of additional FBI flights ferrying Patel and his girlfriend to a George Strait concert in Philadelphia, where the couple watched from a $50,000 luxury suite. Who paid? Patel won't say.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=198320481&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk4MzIwNDgxLCJpYXQiOjE3NzkyMzA5MDUsImV4cCI6MTc4MTgyMjkwNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kbBmhNV1XlyGq4JlqaKY_9pQyz4hZZxSvKpZdJT4ZbQ)
There are the accounts in _The Atlantic_ alleging episodes of such enormous Patel intoxication that associates could not wake him and eventually summoned a SWAT team to break down a door.
Then there are the allegations that Patel inflated FBI arrest statistics.
Every third-rate regime in history has survived for a time by falsifying numbers. Soviet wheat yields, Mussolini's trains, corporate earnings reports, attendance figures at county fairs -- all belong to the same tradition of institutional bunk.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=198320481&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk4MzIwNDgxLCJpYXQiOjE3NzkyMzA5MDUsImV4cCI6MTc4MTgyMjkwNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kbBmhNV1XlyGq4JlqaKY_9pQyz4hZZxSvKpZdJT4ZbQ&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
But there is something especially pathetic in a federal police director allegedly puffing arrest totals like a nightclub owner exaggerating turnout on opening weekend.
And floating on top of the whole septic stew is the image of Patel drinking beers with the Olympic gold medal winning hockey team. Patel presides over the FBI, not like a a serious guardian of the nation's chief law-enforcement apparatus, but rather akin to a divorced regional used car dealer celebrating a sales milestone at Buffalo Wild Wings.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.cz4uG4VROsdwQICe7kCFxB0E5o-11lyRj_nBT4prSFI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198320481)
Yet all these offenses, dispiriting as they are, pale beside the obscenity of the Pearl Harbor episode.
According to reports, Patel participated in a snorkeling excursion at the USS _Arizona_ memorial in Hawaii.
That's right. Patel took a VIP snorkeling tour, arranged just for him by the U.S. Navy. It included swimming near the the wreckage of the U.S.S. Arizona, where 900 sailors and marines died in the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=198320481&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk4MzIwNDgxLCJpYXQiOjE3NzkyMzA5MDUsImV4cCI6MTc4MTgyMjkwNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kbBmhNV1XlyGq4JlqaKY_9pQyz4hZZxSvKpZdJT4ZbQ)
The USS _Arizona_ is not a marina attraction. It is not a theme park lagoon. It is not the sort of place where one straps on flippers and seeks "an experience." It is a war grave.
American sailors and Marines remain entombed in that sunken battleship to this very hour. Oil still seeps upward from the wreckage -- the so-called "black tears" of the dead -- and every halfway civilized person instinctively understands that the place belongs not to tourism but to reverence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

To go snorkeling there as a recreational activity displays precisely the kind of spiritual illiteracy that marks societies in decline. It suggests a man incapable of perceiving that there exist places where the living are obliged to lower their voices, remove their hats, and suppress the modern Trump urge to convert every sacred site into personal content.
The Trump administration might as well stage jet-ski races through Arlington National Cemetery, install a zip line over Gettysburg, and distribute margaritas at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. These abominations would differ from Patel's USS Arizona snorkeling only in degree.
Indeed, the nearest analogies are almost too grotesque to imagine. Snorkeling at Pearl Harbor belongs to the same category as rock climbing the 9/11 Memorial, parasailing above the white headstones at Arlington, or surfing the breakers off Omaha Beach while shouting "Cowabunga!" at the ghosts of the Normandy invasion dead. The offense lies not merely in bad taste but in the annihilation of instinct -- the inability to feel the hush demanded by sacrifice.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Patel's defenders insist his USS Arizona excursion was "respectful, educational, and properly coordinated." Such arguments thoroughly miss the point. Civilization depends less on written rules than on inherited reflexes. A healthy society does not need to issue formal regulations prohibiting drunken karaoke in cathedrals or beer pong atop gravestones. We should all simply know better.
Or we once did.
The truly astonishing aspect of the Arizona affair is that it required no conspiracy, no corruption, no hidden memorandum. It required only the collective moral vacancy of the Department of Justice leadership and the Trump White House. Not a single official in this administration was willing to say, "no, that would be disrespectful."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/469c9bbc-f55a-492a-adf5-9716b5ed9425?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

But modern Washington, D.C. under Trump does not produce custodians of institutions. It produces performers. The contemporary cabinet secretary regards every institution and memorial as a prop in the endless production of self promotion. The military becomes branding. The FBI becomes transportation. National cemeteries become scenery. Historical tragedy becomes experiential tourism for Trump VIPs with security details.
You can see the disease and moral rot everywhere under Trump. Trump MAGA politicians film campaign commercials at disaster sites, despite voting to reject FEMA grants for other states. Trump tech moguls and oligarch bros speak of civilization as though humanity were a software platform awaiting monetization. The Trump era worships access and visibility above everything else. Nothing can remain sacred because sacred things impose limits, and modern Trump narcissism regards limits as tyranny.
So, the Trump FBI director treats bureau jets like a spoiled teenager borrowing daddy's convertible, while simultaneously cultivating the public image of a hard-charging suave patriot.

It is tempting to dismiss Kash Patel simply as another vulgar climber produced by a vulgar Trump age. Yet that would let the Trump culture escape indictment. Cabinet secretaries like Patel do not just emerge from nowhere. They are manufactured by an administration that has replaced honor with publicity, dignity with spectacle, and service with self-display.

**_“US ‘drowning in misinformation’ under RFK Jr, autism advocates say”_ \- The Guardian** For us, this headline alone is enough to give RFK Jr. a big fat F in our gradebook, but we want to know what you think. [**_If you had to give RFK Jr. a grade for his performance as Secretary of Health and Human Services so far, what would it be?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131716546/622066567/2132637479?refcode=LOC_EM_PET_2026.05.19_RFK-Report-Card_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjA2N2FlYS1jYjUzLWYxMTEtOGVmMy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xn6XeqtfS47awKfajDjPV1TeVpcEbW8oXYoEyqHyg-M=&emci=e1f66c46-4251-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=eb067aea-cb53-f111-8ef3-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=5452893) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131716547/622066568/2132637479?refcode=LOC_EM_PET_2026.05.19_RFK-Report-Card_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYjA2N2FlYS1jYjUzLWYxMTEtOGVmMy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xn6XeqtfS47awKfajDjPV1TeVpcEbW8oXYoEyqHyg-M=&emci=e1f66c46-4251-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=eb067aea-cb53-f111-8ef3-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=5452893) While families are working hard to make ends meet and afford basic health care, RFK Jr. has spent his time pushing dangerous ideas, spreading misinformation, and eroding trust in our public health institutions.

The consequences aren’t theoretical — they affect real people.

Friend,

I didn't go to Congress to make headlines. I went there to do the actual work of representing our neighbors.

That’s how we secured $20 million for projects back home, from improving road safety to upgrading our local 911 centers. I’ve always believed in showing up , even for the parts of the job that aren't flashy or exciting.

But the truth is, I can’t get everything done alone. I need a partner in the House who cares more about results than headlines.

That person is Adrian Boafo.

Best,

Sarah Elfreth

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. Team, As we know, Governor Bill Lee and Tennessee Republicans rolled back generations of Civil Rights progress through a rushed special session ordered by Donald Trump to redraw Tennessee’s Congressional district maps. **Voters should pick their representatives, not the other way around. ** **That’s why we sued. Because the new maps were racist, reckless, and wrong.** Last week, the Court denied our emergency request to pause the maps from going into place ahead of the new candidate qualifying deadline. To be clear, our full lawsuit is still pending. Disappointing? Yes. End of story? Not by a long shot. **We’re not backing down in the slightest.** We're building a voter protection program on the ground. We're organizing in every community. We’re training the next generation of Democrats through our Organizing Hub. And Republicans are counting on us to lose hope, to run out of steam, to back down. We're not going to let that happen. Because **Tennessee Democrats are fighting for every Tennessee family regardless of district maps, court rulings, or any other obstacle that they may throw at us.** But we need the resources to back it up. **[Every dollar you give today goes directly toward our organizing and Legal Fund. We can't let that happen here.

Kurt just got into this race. Hey folks,
I sat down with **Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford** -- and we got into everything from Trump's tariffs and Medicaid cuts to what it actually looks like when Democratic governors fight back. We talked affordability, corruption, protecting kids online, and why state-level leadership is going to define the next few years in this country.
You can feel the stakes in this conversation. Aaron's got a personal story that hit me hard, and you can tell he's running because he genuinely understands what working people are going through right now.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:47**] Aaron lays out the blunt reality of Trump's politics -- retribution, billionaire favoritism, and why voting is the only way out of this mess.
* [**00:03:22**] We dig into Nevada's affordability crisis, from housing and gas prices to healthcare costs crushing working families.
* [**00:04:26**] Aaron shares the story of growing up eating stale candy bars for dinner -- and why he keeps a Score bar on his desk as a reminder of who he's fighting for.
* [**00:06:14**] We talk about the groundbreaking Roblox agreement aimed at protecting kids online from predators and harmful platform practices.
* [**00:08:14**] Aaron explains how Democratic attorneys general are taking on Trump's tariffs, Medicaid cuts, and attacks on SNAP benefits -- and actually winning in court.

This episode is really about what leadership looks like when people are hurting. Aaron Ford talks openly about poverty, raising a son on Medicaid and food stamps, and why governors and attorneys general matter so much in this moment. If you're frustrated watching Washington fail working families over and over again, this conversation will remind you there are still people fighting back at the state level -- and winning. If you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

---

|
---

| **Great news — our**second round of campaign mailers** is landing in mailboxes throughout MD-06 right now!**
Just look at what your support has made possible.
To date, we have mailed over 25,000 mailers across Frederick, Washington, Allegany, Montgomery, and Garrett counties. We've reached all permanent absentee voters and targeted every primary voter who voted in 3 of 4 or 4 of 4 of the last primaries.
Supporters are opening these pieces and seeing our strong message of conservative leadership, secure borders, election integrity, faith, family, and freedom.None of this would be happening without YOU.
Your generosity has powered our ground game, yard signs, and now these direct-mail hits reaching thousands of voters. Thank you — from the bottom of my heart.
**But we still have much more work ahead.**
---

| | | | [Chip In Today](https://mo5o1.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEagAv1xDDz6ffJQktWld/38VVwAHOOELG)
---
| | | _New!_
---
|
## NumbersUSA Immigration Survey
---

| I recently completed the immigration survey from NumbersUSA, and one question stood out:
Do you oppose amnesty for the 14–20 million people living in the United States illegally?
My answer: **YES**.
For years, Democrats have pursued open-border policies that undermined our immigration system and created a crisis that is unfair to American citizens and to those who follow the law to come here legally.
This is not about being anti-immigrant. America is a nation of immigrants. It is also a nation of laws.
Before we can have a meaningful conversation about immigration reform, we must first secure the border and restore order to the system.
Rewarding illegal entry with amnesty sends the wrong message and further weakens respect for the rule of law. It is also unfair to the millions of people who have waited patiently and followed the legal process to come to the United States.
I believe in legal immigration, secure borders, and an immigration system that is fair, orderly, and grounded in the rule of law.
That is why I oppose amnesty. Others in my race support it.
---

| | | | [View Survey Results Here](https://mo5o1.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30t7SLZJuGvj8oZsGTh/Qn5qpJRclpMi)
---
| | | | The primary is just weeks away, and to break through and win, we must follow up that mail with a **focused digital advertising campaign** — targeted Facebook & Instagram ads plus personalized text messages that reach voters right where they are.
We still need to raise **$10,000** to make this digital push happen over the next few weeks.Here’s exactly what your donation will help us do:

* **$50** helps us send more than **1,600** personalized text messages to voters
* **$100** funds over **3,300** texts at just $0.03 each
* **$250** powers a full **2-week Facebook + Instagram ad campaign** reaching over **15,000** voters in our district

Every single dollar counts. Whether it’s $25, $50, $100, or more — your support directly fuels our ability to reach voters and turn this momentum into victory on June 23.
---
| [Chip In to Reach Voters Digitally](https://mo5o1.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFVLbJsjvPpRBmyCOr0Bl/Y7cBdosdZk3-)
---
| We’re building something special in MD-06, and we’re just getting started. With your help, we will finish strong.
We're counting on you.
_**Mariela Roca**_ Candidate for Congress, MD-06Proud Mom • Air Force Veteran • Conservative Fighter
---

name: Sarah McBride
subject: I still believe this country is capable of extraordinary progress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
When we organize together, nothing is impossible.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3285%2E21716%2Eov4F4D)
Since Donald Trump re-entered the White House, it feels like every day has come with more bad news. Higher prices. Reckless, illegal new wars. Tax breaks for billionaires while programs working families rely on get cut. And never-ending attacks on our rights.
But we have to remember that this _isn’t_ going to last forever. And one thing giving me hope right now is that Trump’s approval numbers are at an all-time low.
**The American people are fed up, and even many of those who supported him in the last election are ready for a change this November.**
Here’s the thing though: We can’t take these poll numbers for granted. If we want to put an end to Trump’s chaos and cruelty, protect our democracy, and build a government that actually lowers costs and delivers for working families, we have to organize and work for it.
That’s what I’m doing in Congress every single day.
I’m fighting to protect health care and reproductive freedom. To lower the cost of child care and housing. To defend voting rights and stand up to attacks meant to divide us instead of solving real problems.
**But I can’t do this work alone.** Grassroots support is what makes it possible for me to keep showing up, speaking out, organizing, and fighting back against this administration’s dangerous agenda.
[**If you’re with me, will you chip in $5 or any amount you can today to help us keep building the movement that will defeat Trump this November and move our country forward?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260519-1.7yemPG&refcode=em20260519-3285&amount=5&t=2&akid=3285%2E21716%2Eov4F4D)

I still believe this country is capable of extraordinary progress. I believe people are hungry for leaders who put public service over political games. And I believe that when we organize together, nothing is impossible.
Thank you for standing with me,
Sarah McBride

Team, CASA — the Center to Advance Security in America — filed an ethics complaint and is calling for an investigation against me over comments I made about Pete Hegseth on CNN. I stand by what I said: Hegseth has committed war crimes and should be held accountable for them. Explaining that there is historical precedent for war criminals being held accountable for their actions is not a call for violence. [ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

Primary Day is almost over here in Pennsylvania. In just a few hours, the
polls will close — and the next phase of this campaign will begin.

I’ll be honest with you: What comes next won’t be easy.

The far-right will spend millions trying to flip Pennsylvania. They will
do everything they can to turn this race into a referendum on Donald
Trump’s agenda. And the attacks, lies, and outside money are only going to
intensify from here.

But Derek, I’ve
never believed Pennsylvania’s future should be decided by the loudest
voices in Washington.

It should be decided by everyday people like you.

The parents trying to give their kids a better future. The workers trying
to make ends meet. The students looking for opportunity. The seniors
trying to live out their golden years with dignity and respect. The
families who just want a Governor who will focus less on political games
and actually build a Commonwealth where everyone can succeed.

That’s who I’m fighting for, and that’s why this campaign matters so much.

We’ve spent the past four years cutting taxes, investing in our schools,
rebuilding critical infrastructure, creating jobs, and proving government
can still deliver when leaders stay focused on the people they serve.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/738?t=1001&akid=46%2E245147%2E_T99YG ]Now, we have to protect that progress. So before polls close tonight,
I’m asking one last time: Will you chip in $25 to help us hit our $25,000
Primary Day goal and enter the general election ready for the fight ahead?
I know what this grassroots team is capable of, but we have to start
strong, stay disciplined, and make sure the far-right knows exactly what
they’re up against. Please chip in $25 or whatever you can before the
night is over.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

| | Peter, over half of Congress are millionaires. Literally a majority — while the median American income is $60,000 a year.

Being wealthy doesn't make you a bad person. But it's hard to legislate for a reality you've never lived. When you've never stressed about rent or maxed out a credit card, the cost of living becomes a talking point instead of a crisis.

That's why working people aren't getting results.

I ran for Congress at 25 because I knew we couldn't wait for D.C. elites to fix problems they created. I drove for Uber. I racked up credit card debt just to keep my first campaign alive. I don't need briefings to understand what working people are going through, I've lived it.

And I got here because of people like you, chipping in whatever they could. Now I'm running for re-election in a gerrymandered district, because keeping working people in the people's house is how Congress starts working for the many — not the money.

## What We're Hearing
* I recently spoke with President Trump and exposed exposed Congresswomen Lauren Boebert, Victoria Spartz, and Congressman Warren Davidson and Senator Rand Paul for opposing President Trump and campaigning with Thomas Massie in Kentucky over the weekend. Soon afterwards, President Trump used his Truth Social bully pulpit to turn the screws on Boebert and Massie in a powerful message to voters in their congressional districts. President Trump has since called for Lauren Boebert to be primaried, and he has rescinded his prior endorsement of the Colorado Congresswoman.
* After my exclusive interview with Thomas Massie's ex-girlfriend Cynthia West broke, "pinecone" trended nationally on X. To understand why, you'll have to keep reading.
* It's not just President Trump opposing Thomas Massie. Stephen Miller, and other White House officials went all in supporting Ed Gallrein over Massie in what will hopefully be a landslide victory today.
* We learned that President Trump was set to make a big endorsement in Texas today. Hours later, he endorsed Ken Paxton over John Cornyn, all but ending Cornyn's political career... but let's be honest, that was well deserved and long overdue!
* I've posted several times this week about the spectre of the next COVID-like virus, which could lead to more shutdowns, government control, and political leverage for Trump's opponents. The administration is taking these threats seriously enough that the CDC and other agencies have issued public health warnings about Ebola and the Hantavirus. It's possible this was all pre-planned.

### Massie's Nasties Reach the End of the Road
On Saturday, I received a phone call from Cynthia West, Thomas Massie's ex-girlfriend and accuser. She wanted to tell her story in her first full-length on-camera interview with a journalist. Although I was traveling for personal reasons that were very important to me, and it was late at night, it didn't matter. I knew Cynthia's story had to get out there. So I found the time. But, I didn't expect the results to be so explosive.
West, a mother, social worker, advocate, former congressional staffer, and current candidate for Okaloosa County School Board District 5 in Florida, sat down with me and detailed what she says happened during her relationship with Massie, what happened inside Congresswoman Victoria Spartz's congressional office, and why she believes the American people deserve to know the truth before Massie is handed another term in Congress.
With this interview, Thomas Massie's political future is done.
Thomas Massie calls himself an America first conservative. He broke with President Trump over the Epstein files. He has voted against President Trump on everything from war powers to building a new White House ballroom. However, his district voted overwhelmingly for President Trump, and his opponent, Ed Gallrein, is a veteran with big ideas and Trump's endorsement.
The polls are a dead heat, or at least they were before my interview with Cynthia dropped. The election is today, Tuesday, May 19th. As voters head to the polls and decide their next Republican nominee for Congress, they're going to remember "Massie's Nasties."
Cynthia West's allegations are jaw dropping. She claims:
* Massie emotional abused her and told her he wanted to physically "wreck" her for every other man
* He was manipulative, cruel, and allegedly treated women as sexual objects
* He made bizarre, disgusting sexual requests to which Ms. West could never agree
* Just weeks after Massie's wife passed away, Cynthia claims Massie told her he slept with Rep. Lauren Boebert, one of his biggest backers in the primary
* Massie's congressional staff were in on it, purchasing burner phones known as "boner phones" that the Congressman used to communicate with his sexual partners
* Staff and campaign supporters that did Massie's dirty work were called "Massie's Nasties"
* Massie tried to buy West off for $5,000, but when she refused to take the money and be silent, he told her that one person could never make a difference and then lied about their romantic relationship
* Ms. West is speaking out to inject transparency and accountability into our broken political system
* Her life has been turned upside down as a result of making these allegations and speaking truth to power
* The House offices tasked with overseeing misconduct by members of Congress have failed her and need reform
* Massie's staff nicknamed his penis "pinecone" because of its alleged deformed shape

I could go on, but to get the full picture, you'll have to watch the [full, two hour exlcusive interview](https://substack.com/redirect/dad41677-e71c-4d9a-8179-c3499d06f47c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
President Trump reposted the interview on Truth Social. He and his staff are well aware of all of "Massie's Nasties" now that he has been exposed, and Trump's political team is out in full force to support Massie's opponent, Ed Gallrein. Massie's loss will send a strong signal that there's a steep downside to opposing President Trump's MAGA agenda.
**The Angle**
* Until recently, Massie was leading in the polls. President Trump's opposition, my journalism, and the work of grassroots MAGA supporters like our readers have made a tangible difference in this race.
* Due to the extreme allegations made by Ms. West, it's possible Massie will be forced to resign from Congress. If he doesn't, he should be censured and fully investigated by the House Ethics Committee before his term ends.
* With Massie gone, Trump will have removed the greatest thorn in his side within the House Republican Caucus.
* With a razor thin House margin, every vote matters to pass legislation, and every seat matters to maintain the majority in the midterms.
* The mainstream media has largely ignored my interview with Ms. West because they support Massie, a 24/7 anti-Trump obstructionist, but with the President's repost and nearly two million views of the interview on X and Rumble, we're reaching a large audience despite the media's election interference and deliberate censorship of my bombshell reporting.

body:
The energy at our Michigan town hall with Abdul El-Sayed this weekend was absolutely electric.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260519-6258-footer&t=1&akid=6258%2E420207%2E8Y9b_C)
Peter,
I’m still riding the _eclectic_ energy from our town hall in Michigan last weekend with Abdul El-Sayed — a physician, public health champion, and one of the most compelling progressive voices in the country who’s currently running for Senate.
You could feel the passion, urgency, and optimism in the room, watch our video to see for yourself:
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260519.8eV2e0&refcode=em20260519-6258&t=2&akid=6258%2E420207%2E8Y9b_C)
We are fed up with a health care system that puts profit over people’s well being. We are fed up with a government that works for billionaires and leaves working people behind. And we are fed up with leaders who hedge and play it safe while lives hang in the balance.
**Leaders like Abdul give us all something to believe in, which is why I’m asking you to[split a donation between my campaign and Abdul’s today so we can keep growing this progressive movement.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260519.8eV2e0&refcode=em20260519-6258&amount=3&t=3&akid=6258%2E420207%2E8Y9b_C)**
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260519.8eV2e0&amount=3&refcode=em20260519-6258&t=4&akid=6258%2E420207%2E8Y9b_C)**
Abdul doesn’t need pressure to do the right thing — it’s simply who he is. That kind of leadership matters.
He is one of the loudest, clearest voices for Medicare For All in the country right now. As a doctor, he knows what it means when people skip medications they need, go bankrupt trying to get care, or avoid the ER because they’re terrified of the bill.
**And that’s just the beginning of what Abdul stands for.** He’s fighting against the corporate greed that’s squeezing working families on everything from health care to housing to wages. He’s fighting for immigrant rights, reproductive freedom, and an economy that actually works for working people — not just the billionaires at the top.
Abdul also doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs.
When I first ran for Congress back in 2016, I was one of just four candidates who refused corporate PAC money. At the time, people said we were being naive — **but we changed the game.**
And we need to keep going. We need to build a Congress full of people who I don’t have to call and pressure to do the right thing, but will just _do_ the right thing.
So when right-wing billionaires and corporate special interests pour money into races to stop candidates like Abdul (which by the way, they already are), we need to be ready. Our people-powered movement has to match that energy with grassroots donations from people like you.
[**Peter, can I count on you to split a donation of $3 between my campaign and Abdul’s right now so that we can build a government that puts working people first?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260519.8eV2e0&refcode=em20260519-6258&amount=3&t=5&akid=6258%2E420207%2E8Y9b_C)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260519.8eV2e0&amount=3&refcode=em20260519-6258&t=24&akid=6258%2E420207%2E8Y9b_C)**
The town hall in Michigan was inspiring because when working people come together and fight for each other, we CAN win.

clean_body: The energy at our Michigan town hall with Abdul El-Sayed this weekend was absolutely electric. Peter, I’m still riding the eclectic energy from our town hall in Michigan last weekend with Abdul El-Sayed — a physician, public health champion, and one of the most compelling progressive voices in the country who’s currently running for Senate. You could feel the passion, urgency, and optimism in the room, watch our video to see for yourself: We are fed up with a health care system that puts profit over people’s well being. We are fed up with a government that works for billionaires and leaves working people behind. And we are fed up with leaders who hedge and play it safe while lives hang in the balance. Leaders like Abdul give us all something to believe in, which is why I’m asking you to Abdul doesn’t need pressure to do the right thing — it’s simply who he is. That kind of leadership matters. He is one of the loudest, clearest voices for Medicare For All in the country right now. As a doctor, he knows what it means when people skip medications they need, go bankrupt trying to get care, or avoid the ER because they’re terrified of the bill. And that’s just the beginning of what Abdul stands for. He’s fighting against the corporate greed that’s squeezing working families on everything from health care to housing to wages. He’s fighting for immigrant rights, reproductive freedom, and an economy that actually works for working people — not just the billionaires at the top. Abdul also doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs. When I first ran for Congress back in 2016, I was one of just four candidates who refused corporate PAC money. At the time, people said we were being naive — but we changed the game. And we need to keep going. We need to build a Congress full of people who I don’t have to call and pressure to do the right thing, but will just do the right thing. So when right-wing billionaires and corporate special interests pour money into races to stop candidates like Abdul (which by the way, they already are), we need to be ready. Our people-powered movement has to match that energy with grassroots donations from people like you. The town hall in Michigan was inspiring because when working people come together and fight for each other, we CAN win. In solidarity, Pramila Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

Collin County voters were fractured across multiple congressional districts. Five rural counties in Hopkins, Franklin, Morris, Titus, and Delta found themselves overnight in the same congressional district as fast-growing suburban communities more than two hours away. These are communities that might as well be a different world in terms of what their residents need from Washington.
---
[ **END THE MAP RIGGING** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8w-U6GUZWPvOJgxPMRt7Y8_2mKMlGMFj6g6UcG8YbCUsXFTBPNJM6MtoS4-bNmQTeNSIiORzTqNxqOn5nBxIF6nXZ7GumTN4SjWrJcANeojpWWtYaeRBl2FAC05lIOdrY-LREwm_ycL2rDiCfXL7f809uLXzP7jJCsaCBC8z61VaueEpMnkFx_pZkbCjVJiEbBdgS6Vh-NL0vkZqS0QvU2PHHIzCMRiLZxqiat63dFskp7ND1KxGLlxmRnoj5mnxt3XCUyrHxS6ARygsvlm4luaJF72bD2ZUvweX6cKaYuLOgCnFFZWDAT_7lBHPAF6Z2A/4qr/CRo6igZBRcaoOooM5ZrLxA/h2/h001.ocJOS_IFy0lUQXrFLT45Dhd0E7p3xaC0nN0PlBuLC-Y)

[**Help us send someone to Congress who will introduce the**** _Let Voters Choose Act_****and ban this practice at the federal level before another map gets drawn this way.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8w-U6GUZWPvOJgxPMRt7Y8_2mKMlGMFj6g6UcG8YbCUsXFTBPNJM6MtoS4-bNmQTeFFVyyIhhNLRbq4MY-d7LCTrogASIuHxDG6NKaonCJyjSybkeDn1vIs664wyfaYU-mB3HOGLXCq-FkwVm7LyTZGlNKjCcUV00JT3eNHx7UjS4pcqxAm6kaMF8EZt7qBtEPfxcHq6VQkMgTC1UNe7qNbaXEuVKsf0MCdZ4xFwL16mlmfG6g-FlGDanM2BrOwfQv0bYwRz9k9nIpNrEBAc5l80l06MkVhRrExvc7rTWi1YccFwBsSVEaRDWEqDDP-HqA/4qr/CRo6igZBRcaoOooM5ZrLxA/h3/h001.YzNRANLTWbd7p2-kak7Ih2HaQWKwNpDGtjADnN83nP8) My bill would prohibit partisan gerrymandering, ban mid-cycle redistricting like the kind Trump demanded in Tennessee this month, and require maps to be drawn only after each census by independent commissions. And most importantly for TX-03, it would stop the unnecessary splitting of cities and counties that belong together economically and culturally. After I announced this proposal, James Talarico came out in support of a federal ban on partisan gerrymandering for the Texas Senate race. Two candidates in the same cycle, in the same state, aligned on the same reform. **Together, we are a beacon for where the Democratic Party needs to go and TX-03 has a chance to be part of proving it works.** The Democratic Party that wins this country back is going to be the one willing to pick a fight with the corruption that has made governing so comfortable for the people doing it and so miserable for everyone else. Now, he's stepping forward to serve again, but he won't have an easy path.

Democrats see this race as a top opportunity. They will spend heavily, organize aggressively, and do everything they can to flip this seat. We've seen this playbook before – flooding states with outside money and misleading attacks in an effort to gain control of the Senate.

clean_body: We need Kurt Alme in the United States Senate. | I have a clear and urgent request for you, Fellow Patriot. We have an open U.S. Senate seat in Montana, and while this seat has long been considered safely Republican, we cannot afford to take anything for granted in this environment. Our Senate map this cycle is challenging. Republicans are defending far more seats than Democrats, and our resources are stretched across the country. Open seats like this one demand early attention and strong grassroots support. Kurt Alme has spent his career serving the people of Montana as a prosecutor, public servant, and leader committed to the rule of law. He served as U.S. Attorney during both Trump Administrations, focusing on public safety, combating drug trafficking, and protecting Montana communities. Now, he's stepping forward to serve again, but he won't have an easy path. Democrats see this race as a top opportunity. They will spend heavily, organize aggressively, and do everything they can to flip this seat. We've seen this playbook before – flooding states with outside money and misleading attacks in an effort to gain control of the Senate. We can't let that happen here. Kurt just got into this race. He needs the resources to introduce himself to voters, share his record, and communicate a clear conservative vision for Montana's future. This race is about more than one seat. It's about maintaining a Senate Republican majority that can advance a conservative agenda, confirm strong judicial nominees, and provide a check on Washington's excesses. If we lose ground here, we risk losing our ability to lead effectively. Kurt Alme is the kind of candidate we need. He's steady, principled, and focused on results. I hope you'll stand with us. John Thune Republican Leader P.S. Montana is a critical hold for Republicans, and this open seat will be a top target for Democrats. Peter — these RINOs talk out of both sides of their mouths.

They pretend they want election security.

Then they build their entire election strategy based on the same stolen, unsecured, broken election systems they claim to oppose.

The logical contradiction is audacious.

Even for them.

But then again, the audacity of the Establishment knows no bounds.

They want you to believe we can only win by running back to the same weak consultants, fake conservatives, donor-class puppets, and professional losers who told us America First was "too extreme."

I have a remedy:

**Hold the line.**

Do not give the Republican Party back to the same people who said we could never win with bold ideas, moral clarity, and unapologetic truth.

They call me extreme.

Good.

I am an extremist — and I am proud of it.

These are extreme times.

We face extreme enemies.

They hate our faith. They hate our families. They hate our country. They hate the truth. And when men speak their minds, the regime and its mouthpieces mock, smear, censor, and celebrate their destruction before the body is even cold.

So yeah — RINOs better cut the sh*t.

I am on the extreme side.

But I am just right.

Just right about the border.

Just right about election security.

Just right about the Swamp.

Just right about the donor class.

Just right about the fact that America cannot survive if we keep handing power back to cowards who already surrendered.

Minnesota does not need another controlled Republican who checks the right boxes, repeats the approved talking points, and folds the second the Establishment applies pressure.

Minnesota needs a fighter.

That is why I am running for U.S. Senate in 2026.

Not to manage decline.

Not to make peace with corruption.

Not to give the Republican Party back to the same people who betrayed us.

I am running to hold the line, hold the right, and put America First without apology.

#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104443?refcode=em20260519-10465&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10465%2E614464%2E3nsG_4)
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked Senate races in every corner of the country, and I know how to read a map. So hear me when I say this: **New Hampshire is keeping me up at night.**
I’m watching this year’s races closely, and money is pouring into Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Alaska, and Maine. That’s critical because those races are part of Democrats’ path to retaking the Senate.
But here’s what’s scaring the hell out of me: **If Chris Pappas loses New Hampshire, Democrats need to flip FIVE seats instead of four to take back the Senate. That math doesn’t work. Full stop.**
**[Before you read another word, chip in $5 or whatever you can to Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the reason Democrats lose the Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104443?refcode=em20260519-10465&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10465%2E614464%2E3nsG_4)**

---
Chris is up just one point. One. 45-44. **That is a tied race.** And while the whole country is staring at Georgia and North Carolina, New Hampshire is sitting there in a dead heat with nobody riding to the rescue.
John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — has the name, the money, and a Republican machine that knows exactly what’s at stake here. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire red and let the map do the rest.
And right now? **They’ve got a real shot at doing exactly that.**
Chris Pappas is the only guy who can win this seat. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times. He knows how to bring people together. But he cannot — _cannot_ — do this alone when every check is being written and every eyeball is looking somewhere else.
So here’s what I need from you:

I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire _is_ the map. You hold this seat, and Democrats have a real path to the majority. You lose it, and it doesn’t matter what happens in North Carolina, Texas, Maine, or anywhere else.
Don’t let New Hampshire be the reason we come up one seat short.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104443?refcode=em20260519-10465&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=10465%2E614464%2E3nsG_4)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

name: Democratic Headquarters
subject: “I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anybody.”
body:
---
_**“I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anybody.”_** Derek, can you guess whose mouth that statement came out of just seven days ago? If you guessed the president of the United States — you’d (**_unfortunately**_) be correct. If you’re fed up with the dictator-in-chief and are ready to join the DNC in the fight to hold him accountable and make him virtually powerless for the rest of his term, [**you can donate to help power our work here. But we hope you’ll keep reading to hear more from us on _why_ you should chip in.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260519_7198_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7198_22930333_tdEXB1&akid=7198%2E22930333%2EtdEXB1) To many of us, it’s always been crystal clear that Donald Trump has never cared, doesn’t care, and will never care about the people who make up this country unless their net worth has more than 10 digits. But statements like this are reaching his base, and his support is dropping among his own supporters. People across the country, regardless of political affiliation, are _sick and tired_ of the status quo. They’re sick of corruption, they’re sick of endless wars, and they’re sick of that spike of stress they get every time they pay rent or buy groceries or fill up their gas tank. _We’re sick of it too, Derek._ That’s why we’re fighting every day, around the clock, to take this administration on from every possible angle. And it’s why we’re so excited to see so many Democratic candidates running on platforms of change and affordability — candidates like **Sherrod Brown, Graham Platner, and Jon Ossoff** are laser-focused on improving Americans’ financial situation. And recently elected Democrats like across the country continue to prove that real change is possible. Democrats in New York City balanced their budget while increasing funding for public libraries and universal childcare and lowering bus fares. Democrats in Virginia have passed bills to cap the cost of prescription drugs, lower Virginians’ energy bills, and provide paid family and medical leave statewide. And Democrats in New Jersey proposed a budget that would cut New Jersey’s deficit in half while making historic investments in affordability-focused programs, banned ICE from launching operations on state property, and joined lawsuits against federal tariffs driving up costs. _This_ is what’s possible when we elect people who _do_ care about Americans’ financial situations. [**So if you want more of those people in office, this November and beyond, we hope you’ll consider donating to the DNC today. Thank you for reading, Derek. Whether you chip in $3, $7, or $14, we’ll put your donation to work immediately to elect Democrats up and down the ballot across the country.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260519_7198_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7198_22930333_tdEXB1&akid=7198%2E22930333%2EtdEXB1) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260519_7198_fr&refcode2=7198_22930333_tdEXB1&akid=7198%2E22930333%2EtdEXB1)**

I’ll always have your back. Can you have mine?
| **Friend, I’m officially facing off against Jon Husted for Ohio’s Senate seat.**

So much hard work has brought us to this point, and I’m beyond grateful to everyone who has devoted their time, energy, and dollars to support my campaign so far. Because of you, Ohio is in play and we have a serious shot of flipping this seat and retaking a Senate majority.

**But the truth is, it’s only getting harder from here.**

Experts agree that Ohio is one of the most likely seats to flip this year, and it’s the key state in our path to Senate control. National Republicans have already poured a tsunami of outside resources into Ohio to attack me and my record – and I can guarantee they’re about to unleash a new wave of attacks.

I’ll have more to say soon, but in the meantime, I have to candidly ask for your support. We’re entering a brand new phase of this race, and I need you by my side.

subject: I don’t expect you to write a $17M check
body:
I can’t out-organize a nearly nine-figure barrage of attack ads alone.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1478%2E124072%2EuLb9vH)
| | | |
---
Roy here, Peter – I’ll be blunt:
We have to raise a lot more money to keep up in this race.
**[The pathway to Senate control runs straight through North Carolina, so I’m reaching out to personally ask if you’ll chip in $17 today to help me flip this battleground Senate seat blue.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11631?t=8&akid=1478%2E124072%2EuLb9vH)**
When experts at Inside Elections came out with their updated 2026 Senate rankings listing North Carolina as one of just three “Toss Up” races – and the only one currently held by the GOP – we knew the GOP was going to come after us with millions.
However, we didn’t expect _this_ much, _this_ early.
**Peter, two Republican super PACs pledged attack ad buys worth just shy of $100 MILLION combined to defeat me. **
Now with all eyes on North Carolina’s election, and even more money being spent to keep it red, it’s clear that our momentum has MAGA Republicans terrified.
While I’ve won my fair share of tough races, I simply can’t withstand a nearly nine-figure barrage of attack ads on my own. In what’s shaping up to be the most expensive Senate race in history, the only way I stand a chance against the GOP’s outsized investing is with grassroots support from **people like you, Peter. **
**[I know you can't write me a $17 million check, and I wouldn’t ask that of you in the first place. What I’m hoping you _can_ do, however, is chip in $17 (or any amount) to my campaign – and that's all I'm asking. Please, can I count on you?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11631?t=9&akid=1478%2E124072%2EuLb9vH)**

I really appreciate it.

Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8188?t=2&akid=1478%2E124072%2EuLb9vH)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Jamie Davis
subject: I can still hear his voice: “Dad, get me out.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
August 8, 2009, is a date I will never forget.
Just days before his 19th birthday, my son Justin was out in the fields with us, doing what this family has done for over three generations—farming the Louisiana delta. A breakdown in our combine left corn spilled across the ground, and as we worked to recover it, Justin got too close. In an instant, his pant leg was caught, and the thresher pulled him in.
I can still hear his voice: “Dad, get me out.”
And there was nothing I could do.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Multiple miracles occurred that day: When it initially happened he wasn’t in pain because his nerves were pinched so tightly in the machine. Nor was he bleeding because he was caught so tight in there.
It took the jaws of life to tear apart that machine and when the metal finally gave way he let out a scream that I will never forget for the rest of my life.
The paramedics quickly sprang into action and he was airlifted to Jackson, Mississippi, where Doctors fought to save his leg, but the injury and infection from all the dirt and debris were too severe. Justin lost his leg from below the knee.
That day could have broken us. Instead, it showed me what makes Louisiana strong.
Neighbors, first responders from two parishes (what we call counties in Louisiana), and a doctor who wasn’t even on duty, Dr. Ron Gregg, a farmer himself and longtime family friend — showed up because that’s what rural communities do. They take care of each other. They don’t ask if it’s their job or jurisdiction. They just show up.
Today, Justin is 35. He runs our farm. He’s built a life, with a fiancée and a family of his own. He still hunts, fishes, and works the land — just with a prosthetic leg and the same determination that carried him through that day.
But the truth is, the kind of community that saved Justin is disappearing. Rural hospitals are closing. Doctors like Dr. Gregg—who live in our communities, who know our families—are harder to find. Too many of our kids feel like they have to leave home to build a future.
And my family, who first worked this Louisiana delta soil as slaves and sharecroppers, and now as farmers who own this land, have put too much blood into this soil for us to leave and go somewhere else.
I have to take a stand and fight for our way of life and it’s why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
If you believe in that fight, I’m asking you to stand with me today. A Democratic win here is the first step in taking our state back from the far-right whose policies of atomization and vicious corporatism are tearing our communities apart.
And mark my words, a win is possible, Democrats just won a deep red special election here by a landslide. The blue wave will wash over Louisiana and we will flip this seat but only if we fight for it. Will you please make a contribution of $50, $20, or even just $10 to help us in our fight to restore the Louisiana that we love so dearly. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
HELP ELECT A REAL WORKING-CLASS CHAMPION TO THE SENATE! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Thank you. Your support means more than you know.
Jamie Davis
Democrat for US Senate
Louisiana

He still hunts, fishes, and works the land — just with a prosthetic leg and the same determination that carried him through that day. But the truth is, the kind of community that saved Justin is disappearing. Rural hospitals are closing. Doctors like Dr. Gregg—who live in our communities, who know our families—are harder to find. Too many of our kids feel like they have to leave home to build a future. And my family, who first worked this Louisiana delta soil as slaves and sharecroppers, and now as farmers who own this land, have put too much blood into this soil for us to leave and go somewhere else. I have to take a stand and fight for our way of life and it’s why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana. If you believe in that fight, I’m asking you to stand with me today. A Democratic win here is the first step in taking our state back from the far-right whose policies of atomization and vicious corporatism are tearing our communities apart. And mark my words, a win is possible, Democrats just won a deep red special election here by a landslide. The blue wave will wash over Louisiana and we will flip this seat but only if we fight for it. Will you please make a contribution of $50, $20, or even just $10 to help us in our fight to restore the Louisiana that we love so dearly. * * *
Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin.
---
And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. Violent agitators hurled rocks, frozen water bottles, and exploding fireworks directly at police officers. Buildings were vandalized and looted. Police vehicles were set on fire. A rioter was caught with a Molotov cocktail. Officers were injured. The city was teetering on the edge of complete chaos, and everyone knew it.
On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held.
**No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him.**
And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza.
Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops.
Chance became one of his targets.
| Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training.
---
My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is **now scheduled for June of this year.** Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June.
